raw_text: Draw from, compare, build, and integrate prior knowledge with the material in the text, addressing inconsistencies or gaps and adding to knowledge repertoires as appropriate. (I)
competency_statement: Use what you already know to understand new information in a text, compare it with the text, and add new knowledge while noticing and resolving any differences or missing information.
observable_behaviors: Recall relevant prior knowledge related to the text topic.
Compare prior knowledge with information presented in the text.
Identify inconsistencies or gaps between prior knowledge and the text.
Integrate new information from the text into existing knowledge.
Adjust understanding when encountering conflicting information.
skill_clauses: Draw from prior knowledge to understand the text.
Compare prior knowledge with information in the text.
Build and integrate new knowledge with prior knowledge.
Address inconsistencies or gaps between prior knowledge and the text.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize prior knowledge related to the text topic.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply prior knowledge to understand and interpret the text.
student_actions.representation_modeling: Model connections between prior knowledge and text information.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how prior knowledge and text information are compared and integrated, addressing inconsistencies or gaps.
student_actions.comprehension_response: Respond to texts by integrating prior knowledge and new information, noting any inconsistencies or gaps.
